product_metadata.title: Genuine Fred HALF PINT Glass Milk Carton Creamer
features: Creamer shaped like a milk carton; just like the ones you used to get in the school cafeteria
Made from artfully blown and molded glass
Simple, elegant, whimsical - it's a gem de la crème.
description: Got cream? Half Pint is an artfully blown and molded glass creamer that captures the comforting familiarity of a mini milk carton, just like the ones Mrs. Fontaine used to pass out in the school cafeteria. Simple, elegant, whimsical - it's a gem de la crème. Hand-wash only. Measures approximately 3.77"(W) x 4.39"(H) x 2.95"(L).
